name: NoTear FPS Optimizer
description: Triet tieu xe hinh (Screen Tearing) khi Unlock FPS trong GD 2.2081 bang Draw Divide & Scanline VBlank Sync.

enable-mod.name: Bat Anti-Tear Engine
enable-mod.description: Kich hoat bo xu ly chong xe hinh khi Unlock FPS.

draw-divide.name: Che do Smart Draw Divide (Khuyen dung)
draw-divide.description: Giu nguyen do nhay Input/Physics 240-360Hz nhung chi xuat hinh theo Target Render FPS de xoa 100% xe hinh va giam tai GPU.

render-fps.name: Target Render FPS (Draw Divide)
render-fps.description: So khung hinh hien thi moi giay (Dat 60 cho man hinh 60Hz de khop chu ky quet).

scanline-sync.name: DWM VBlank / Scanline Phase Sync
scanline-sync.description: Can chinh thoi diem SwapBuffers trung voi chu ky VBlank cua man hinh.

scanline-offset-us.name: Scanline Timing Offset (Microseconds)
scanline-offset-us.description: Do lech pha so voi VBlank (micro-giay) de day vet xe ra khoi mep man hinh.

true-borderless.name: Ep cua so True Borderless (Windows 11 DWM)
true-borderless.description: Chuyen cua so sang Borderless Windowed de Windows 11 DWM chong xe hinh bang DXGI Flip Model.
